title: PDF-to-Printed Page Maps
description: Maps each PDF page index to its corresponding printed page number(s) for each issue. Derived from human-reviewed anchor points via the trains_magazine_extractor page-number inference pipeline.

issues.description: Map from issue date (YYYY-MM) to page mapping data.

pdf_to_printed.description: Maps a 1-based PDF page index (as a numeric string key) to a list of printed page identifiers. Single-element lists for normal pages; multi-element for gatefold pages that span multiple printed pages. Chrome and cover pages without a printed number are omitted. Printed page identifiers are strings: purely numeric ("42") or lettered for insert sections ("30b", "30c").
